Sep. 28, 2026


# Toyota Employees Win Medals for Excellence in 5 categories at the 48th WorldSkills Competition


News ReleaseEvents


Download all images


Toyota City, Japan, September 28, 2026―At Toyota Motor Corporation, seven competitors participated in seven categories at the 48th WorldSkills Competition*1, held from September 23 to 26 in Shanghai, China, winning Medallions for Excellence*2 in 5 categories.
In total, Toyota contestants from India, United Kingdom, Japan in the competition.


## Medallion for Excellence Winners


### Toyota Motor Corporation


Field IT Network Systems Administration


Division Logistics & Information Production Engineering Div.


Name Kojiro Nishimura


Field Cloud Computing


Division Toyota Monozukuri Development Div.


Name Osuke Oyaizu


Field CNC Milling


Division Technical Development & Prototype Div.


Name Yuto Yamada


Field Electronics


Division Mobility Safety Platform Development Div.


Name Yusei Kameda


Field Car Painting


Division Design Management Div.


Name Shiyota Sugata


### Toyota Kirloskar Motor Private Ltd.


Field Mechatronics*3


Name DEEPU MUDIGEREPALYA SRINIVASA ･ JAYANTH KARIYAPPA


### Toyota Motor Manufacturing UK Ltd.


Field Mechatronics


Name EMILY BETTRIDGE ･ ELIZABETH HOPKINSON


*1 WorldSkills Competition This is a competition where young skilled professionals compete to showcase their technical abilities. It has been held since 1950 with the aim of promoting vocational training, fostering international exchange among skilled workers, and enhancing the recognition of technical skills. It is often referred to as the 'Olympics of skills' where young people from around the world compete in various trades.


*2 Medallions for Excellence An award presented to competitors who demonstrated outstanding performance and achieved results ranking just below the Gold, Silver, and Bronze medalists.


*3 Mechatronics is a category that is performed in pairs.
